verdict.rationale: Netlify ships an official CLI (`npm i -g netlify-cli`, then `netlify deploy`). Its docs say it deploys sites and manages projects from the terminal, deploys straight from the working directory, and even allows anonymous deploys with no login. A probe confirms the official CLI docs exist, and the REST API offers a second programmatic route that skips the dashboard. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the CLI deploy flow works as documented.
